descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94745 state 3 · “Raw dictation kept, error shown, Generate disabled until Save succeeds (PR #53)”. Mixed: stated part — (b) a failed pre-round parse keeps the raw text, shows the error and leaves rows unchanged; our part — extraction failure retry, reload/leave right after Generate (B03 decision) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B03 · fixed on 8b4be94a · was S0 · no longer counted

A medication hold dictated before Generate is silently lost if the page reloads or the app closes before extraction finishes: the drug still shows active, no message (both settings)

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: fixed: medication extraction runs on the server after the note; a hold survives a reload during Generate, both modes (dev, TC-19/S27).

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S27 Medication changes are never silently lost: extraction or parse fails, or the physician reloads or leaves right after Generate (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U22 A medication change is never silently lost: if medication extraction or the pre-round parse fails, the typed or dictated text is kept, the rows stay as they were and a clear message says what failed; … (UAT 3.5 (retry, backup model or a clear message; the physician taps Generate and can move to the next patient); UAT Empty & Failure States (nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost; applies to every TC))
  • T9 No dictated medication or medication change is silently dropped, including in a long dictation with many drugs and several changes. (TFA-94229 R9 (Principle 2); UAT TC-19 (the tracker shows the medications the physician dictated); TFA-92597 What (keep the tracker current))
  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on … (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 What; TFA-92597 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local stack, fresh @roundai.test physician; Hospital patient with Apixaban 5 mg BID active, Nursing Home resident with Metformin 500 mg BID active; model calls answered at the socket (trackActionRequests), one of them failing where the cell says so

When (a) Hospital: Save & Extract 'Hold the apixaban, procedure tomorrow.' with ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents rejecting, then Save & Extract again with a working answer. (b) Hospital: pre-round Save Note with ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes rejecting. …

Then (a) the encounter text stays in the box, the rows deep-equal the rows before, and a visible message names medications; the retry gives exactly one Held apixaban row. (b) Medications panel rows unchanged, the pre-round error message shown, the raw text kept. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U22 / T9: a dictated change is either in the rows or named in an explicit message, never silently missing; the original text is never lost. The existing lane-A test 'Save & Extract keeps task updates when medication extraction fails' (S04) covers only (a)'s message and the saved notes. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the bug was fixed on 8b4be94a and this re-test passes, so its status is kept (the rows below are about the older build).

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

A medication hold dictated before Generate is silently lost if the page reloads before the medication extraction finishes: the drug stays 'active' and nothing tells the physician the hold was not saved, in both Nursing Home and Hospital.

Evidence: Allure 55c3cfe9, newspec-c. Part (c), NH, failed in 4 runs; part (d-reload), Hospital, failed in 2 runs. The control run without a reload shows Held. EncounterTab.tsx starts extractEncounterMedications only after onNext(), and useNoteGeneration saves the note before the med follow-up. This breaks TC-19 U22 (UAT 3.5 / Empty & Failure States). generateNote was mocked, pending Quinn's OK. Not in the dev report or ledger.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev/newspec-c.
